MATERIAL PARAMETERS
Units shown per control
Critical-friction direction coefficient (c1)

Relates the deformation-direction mapping to the critical friction angle.

Dilatancy direction coefficient (c2)

Adjusts the dilatancy-dependent direction mapping and its curvature.

Density-departure coefficient (c3)

Weights the difference between critical and current void ratio in the stress-rate law.

Stress-rate scale (c4, Pa)

Sets the stress-valued offset in the stiffness scale c4 + c5 times stress magnitude. It does not authorize zero-stress initialization.

Pressure-stiffening slope (c5)

Sets the dimensionless slope of the stress-dependent stiffness scale and also enters the pressure dependence of critical void ratio.

Zero-pressure critical void ratio (e_c0)

Sets the critical void-ratio reference at zero pressure; admissible runs still require nonzero effective stress.

Minimum void ratio (e_min)

Sets the lower void-ratio reference and the admissible density boundary.

Recorded description. Review status in this text reflects when it was written; see the accepted review for its current scope. Draft laboratory preview of Kolymbas2015 Eq31 sand law, fixed spatial frame and zero spin. Compression-positive effective Cauchy stress and void ratio; explicit schema v0.3. Default parameters are the separately attributed Kolymbas/Bathaeian2019 illustrative calibration, not a 2015 experimental reproduction. Conservative positive-definite/nonzero stress interior, density margin and bounded matrix-exponential support are numerical restrictions. Exact zero-loading continuation is selected; zero-stress evolution and zero-loading update tangents are unresolved. Supply stress/e explicitly. No finite-rotation, matched preparation, experimental validation or scientific admission claim.

Equation form: strain_path_rate. State equations are residuals for implicit models, or increments per unit path fraction for strain-path rate models.

scaled_stress = sigma/c4
stress_measure = norm(scaled_stress)
stress_unit = select(stress_measure > 0,scaled_stress/stress_measure,0*I)
stress_value = c4*stress_measure
loading_measure = norm(de)
loading_abs_sum = abs(dot(de,sym(1,0,0,0,0,0)))+abs(dot(de,sym(0,1,0,0,0,0)))+abs(dot(de,sym(0,0,1,0,0,0)))+abs(dot(de,sym(0,0,0,1,0,0)))+abs(dot(de,sym(0,0,0,0,1,0)))+abs(dot(de,sym(0,0,0,0,0,1)))
loading_unit = select(loading_measure > 0,de/loading_measure,0*I)
v = trace(loading_unit)
a = c1*exp(-c2*v)
direction_argument = -a*loading_unit
direction_tensor = expm(direction_argument)
direction_unit = direction_tensor/norm(direction_tensor)
B = (ec0-emin)/(ec0+1)*exp(-(1+emin)/c5*log1p(c5*stress_measure))
ec = (emin+B)/(1-B)
K = (c4+c5*stress_value)/(e-emin)
sxx = dot(stress_unit,sym(1,0,0,0,0,0))
syy = dot(stress_unit,sym(0,1,0,0,0,0))
szz = dot(stress_unit,sym(0,0,1,0,0,0))
sxy = dot(stress_unit,sym(0,0,0,1,0,0))
syz = dot(stress_unit,sym(0,0,0,0,1,0))
sxz = dot(stress_unit,sym(0,0,0,0,0,1))
minor_two = sxx*syy-sxy**2/2
stress_det = sxx*syy*szz-(sxx*syz**2+syy*sxz**2+szz*sxy**2)/2+sxy*syz*sxz/sqrt(2)
sigma : select(loading_measure > 0,K*((v-c3*ec)*direction_unit+c3*e*stress_unit)*loading_measure,0*sigma)
e : -(1+e)*trace(de)
Declared domain
ec0 > emin
e > emin
e-emin >= 1e-8
e <= 3
stress_measure >= 1e-10
stress_measure <= 1e10
sxx > 0
syy > 0
szz > 0
minor_two > 1.4210854715202004e-14
stress_det > 1.4210854715202004e-14
B > 0
B < 1
ec > emin
loading_measure <= 1000
select(loading_abs_sum > 0,loading_measure >= 1e-140,loading_measure >= 0)
norm(direction_argument) <= 64
